title: types are incorrect for streaming tool call inputs

linked_prs.title: fix (ui): tool input can be undefined during input-streaming
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Tool inputs could be undefined during streaming, leading to breakages ( #7184 ).

## Summary

Add `undefined` as possible value for input during tool call streaming.

## Related Issues

Fixes #7184
